Validate an explicit cross-validation partition

Source: R/folds.R
cv_folds.Rd

Every observation must be tested exactly once. Training and test indices must be nonempty, unique, disjoint, and within 1:n. Training sets may exclude additional observations, as in buffered CV. Repeated CV should be audited one complete partition at a time.

Usage

cv_folds(folds, n)

Arguments

folds

A list whose elements each contain integer vectors train and test; or a vector of fold labels of length n.

n

Number of training observations.

Value

A list of class spcv_folds, with one train/test list per fold and an n attribute recording the number of observations.

Examples

cv_folds(c(1, 2, 1, 2), n = 4)
#> [[1]]
#> [[1]]$train
#> [1] 2 4
#> 
#> [[1]]$test
#> [1] 1 3
#> 
#> 
#> [[2]]
#> [[2]]$train
#> [1] 1 3
#> 
#> [[2]]$test
#> [1] 2 4
#> 
#> 
#> attr(,"class")
#> [1] "spcv_folds" "list"      
#> attr(,"n")
#> [1] 4
